verses.original: בַּשְּׁבִיעִ֕י בְּעֶשְׂרִ֥ים וְאֶחָ֖ד לַחֹ֑דֶשׁ הָיָה֙ דְּבַר־ יְהוָ֔ה בְּיַד־ חַגַּ֥י הַנָּבִ֖יא לֵאמֹֽר׃
verses.transliteration: baš·šə·ḇî·‘î bə·‘eś·rîm wə·’e·ḥāḏ la·ḥō·ḏeš hā·yāh də·ḇar- Yah·weh bə·yaḏ- ḥag·gay han·nā·ḇî lê·mōr
verses.literal: On the twenty-first day . . . of the seventh month the word of the LORD came through Haggai the prophet saying
verses.literalPt: NO sétimo mês, ao vigésimo primeiro dia do mês, veio a palavra do SENHOR por intermédio do profeta Ageu, dizendo:

verses.original: אֱמָר־ נָ֗א אֶל־ זְרֻבָּבֶ֤ל בֶּן־ שַׁלְתִּיאֵל֙ פַּחַ֣ת יְהוּדָ֔ה וְאֶל־ יְהוֹשֻׁ֥עַ בֶּן־ יְהוֹצָדָ֖ק הַכֹּהֵ֣ן הַגָּד֑וֹל וְאֶל־ שְׁאֵרִ֥ית הָעָ֖ם לֵאמֹֽר׃
verses.transliteration: ’ĕ·mār- nā ’el- zə·rub·bā·ḇel ben- šal·tî·’êl pa·ḥaṯ yə·hū·ḏāh wə·’el- yə·hō·wō·šu·a‘ ben- yə·hō·w·ṣā·ḏāq hak·kō·hên hag·gā·ḏō·wl wə·’el- šə·’ê·rîṯ hā·‘ām lê·mōr
verses.literal: Speak . . . to Zerubbabel son of Shealtiel governor of Judah and to Joshua son of Jehozadak the high priest and also to the remnant of the people Ask them
verses.literalPt: Fala agora a Zorobabel, filho de Sealtiel, governador de Judá, e a Josué, filho de Jozadaque, sumo sacerdote, e ao restante do povo, dizendo:

verses.original: מִ֤י בָכֶם֙ הַנִּשְׁאָ֔ר אֲשֶׁ֤ר רָאָה֙ אֶת־ הַבַּ֣יִת הַזֶּ֔ה בִּכְבוֹד֖וֹ הָרִאשׁ֑וֹן וּמָ֨ה אַתֶּ֜ם רֹאִ֤ים אֹתוֹ֙ עַ֔תָּה הֲל֥וֹא כָמֹ֛הוּ כְּאַ֖יִן בְּעֵינֵיכֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: mî ḇā·ḵem han·niš·’ār ’ă·šer rā·’āh ’eṯ- hab·ba·yiṯ haz·zeh biḵ·ḇō·w·ḏōw hā·ri·šō·wn ū·māh ’at·tem rō·’îm ’ō·ṯōw ‘at·tāh hă·lō·w ḵā·mō·hū kə·’a·yin bə·‘ê·nê·ḵem
verses.literal: Who is left among you who saw this house in its former glory How does it look to you now Does it not appear to you like nothing in comparison
verses.literalPt: Quem há entre vós que tendo ficado, viu esta casa na sua primeira glória? E como a vedes agora? Não é esta como nada diante dos vossos olhos, comparada com aquela?

verses.original: וְעַתָּ֣ה חֲזַ֣ק זְרֻבָּבֶ֣ל׀ נְאֻם־ יְהוָ֡ה וַחֲזַ֣ק יְהוֹשֻׁ֣עַ בֶּן־ יְהוֹצָדָק֩ הַכֹּהֵ֨ן הַגָּד֜וֹל וַחֲזַ֨ק כָּל־ עַ֥ם הָאָ֛רֶץ נְאֻם־ יְהוָ֖ה וַֽעֲשׂ֑וּ כִּֽי־ אֲנִ֣י אִתְּכֶ֔ם נְאֻ֖ם יְהוָ֥ה צְבָאֽוֹת׃
verses.transliteration: wə·‘at·tāh ḥă·zaq zə·rub·bā·ḇel nə·’um- Yah·weh wa·ḥă·zaq yə·hō·wō·šu·a‘ ben- yə·hō·w·ṣā·ḏāq hak·kō·hên hag·gā·ḏō·wl wa·ḥă·zaq kāl- ‘am hā·’ā·reṣ nə·’um- Yah·weh wa·‘ă·śū kî- ’ă·nî ’it·tə·ḵem nə·’um Yah·weh ṣə·ḇā·’ō·wṯ
verses.literal: But now be strong O Zerubbabel declares the LORD Be strong O Joshua son of Jehozadak the high priest And be strong all you people of the land declares the LORD Work For I am with you declares the LORD of Hosts
verses.literalPt: Ora, pois, esforça-te, Zorobabel, diz o SENHOR, e esforça-te, Josué, filho de Jozadaque, sumo sacerdote, e esforça-te, todo o povo da terra, diz o SENHOR, e trabalhai; porque eu sou convosco, diz o SENHOR dos Exércitos,

verses.original: אֶֽת־ הַדָּבָ֞ר אֲשֶׁר־ כָּרַ֤תִּי אִתְּכֶם֙ בְּצֵאתְכֶ֣ם מִמִּצְרַ֔יִם וְרוּחִ֖י עֹמֶ֣דֶת בְּתוֹכְכֶ֑ם אַל־ תִּירָֽאוּ׃ס
verses.transliteration: ’eṯ- had·dā·ḇār ’ă·šer- kā·rat·tî ’it·tə·ḵem bə·ṣê·ṯə·ḵem mim·miṣ·ra·yim wə·rū·ḥî ‘ō·me·ḏeṯ bə·ṯō·wḵ·ḵem ’al- tî·rā·’ū
verses.literal: This is the promise I made to you when you came out of Egypt And My Spirit remains among you do not be afraid
verses.literalPt: Segundo a palavra da aliança que fiz convosco, quando saístes do Egito, o meu Espírito permanece no meio de vós; não temais.

verses.original: כִּ֣י כֹ֤ה אָמַר֙ יְהוָ֣ה צְבָא֔וֹת ע֥וֹד אַחַ֖ת מְעַ֣ט הִ֑יא וַאֲנִ֗י מַרְעִישׁ֙ אֶת־ הַשָּׁמַ֣יִם וְאֶת־ הָאָ֔רֶץ וְאֶת־ הַיָּ֖ם וְאֶת־ הֶחָרָבָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: kî ḵōh ’ā·mar Yah·weh ṣə·ḇā·’ō·wṯ ‘ō·wḏ ’a·ḥaṯ mə·‘aṭ hî wa·’ă·nî mar·‘îš ’eṯ- haš·šā·ma·yim wə·’eṯ- hā·’ā·reṣ wə·’eṯ- hay·yām wə·’eṯ- he·ḥā·rā·ḇāh
verses.literal: For this is what the LORD of Hosts says Once more in a little while . . . I will shake the heavens and the earth the sea and the dry land
verses.literalPt: Porque assim diz o SENHOR dos Exércitos: Ainda uma vez, daqui a pouco, farei tremer os céus e a terra, o mar e a terra seca;

verses.original: וְהִרְעַשְׁתִּי֙ אֶת־ כָּל־ הַגּוֹיִ֔ם וּבָ֖אוּ חֶמְדַּ֣ת כָּל־ הַגּוֹיִ֑ם וּמִלֵּאתִ֞י אֶת־ הַבַּ֤יִת הַזֶּה֙ כָּב֔וֹד אָמַ֖ר יְהוָ֥ה צְבָאֽוֹת׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hir·‘aš·tî ’eṯ- kāl- hag·gō·w·yim ū·ḇā·’ū ḥem·daṯ kāl- hag·gō·w·yim ū·mil·lê·ṯî ’eṯ- hab·ba·yiṯ haz·zeh kā·ḇō·wḏ ’ā·mar Yah·weh ṣə·ḇā·’ō·wṯ
verses.literal: I will shake all the nations and they will come with all their treasures . . . . . . and I will fill this house with glory says the LORD of Hosts
verses.literalPt: E farei tremer todas as nações, e virão coisas preciosas de todas as nações, e encherei esta casa de glória, diz o SENHOR dos Exércitos.

verses.original: לִ֥י הַכֶּ֖סֶף וְלִ֣י הַזָּהָ֑ב נְאֻ֖ם יְהוָ֥ה צְבָאֽוֹת׃
verses.transliteration: lî hak·ke·sep̄ wə·lî haz·zā·hāḇ nə·’um Yah·weh ṣə·ḇā·’ō·wṯ
verses.literal: The silver is Mine and the gold is Mine declares the LORD of Hosts
verses.literalPt: Minha é a prata, e meu é o ouro, disse o SENHOR dos Exércitos.

verses.original: גָּד֣וֹל יִֽהְיֶ֡ה כְּבוֹד֩ הַבַּ֨יִת הַזֶּ֤ה הָאַֽחֲרוֹן֙ מִן־ הָ֣רִאשׁ֔וֹן אָמַ֖ר יְהוָ֣ה צְבָא֑וֹת וּבַמָּק֤וֹם הַזֶּה֙ אֶתֵּ֣ן שָׁל֔וֹם נְאֻ֖ם יְהוָ֥ה צְבָאֽוֹת׃פ
verses.transliteration: gā·ḏō·wl yih·yeh kə·ḇō·wḏ hab·ba·yiṯ haz·zeh hā·’a·ḥă·rō·wn min- hā·ri·šō·wn ’ā·mar Yah·weh ṣə·ḇā·’ō·wṯ ū·ḇam·mā·qō·wm haz·zeh ’et·tên šā·lō·wm nə·’um Yah·weh ṣə·ḇā·’ō·wṯ
verses.literal: The latter glory of this house will be greater than the former says the LORD of Hosts And in this place I will provide peace declares the LORD of Hosts
verses.literalPt: A glória desta última casa será maior do que a da primeira, diz o SENHOR dos Exércitos, e neste lugar darei a paz, diz o SENHOR dos Exércitos.

verses.original: בְּעֶשְׂרִ֤ים וְאַרְבָּעָה֙ לַתְּשִׁיעִ֔י בִּשְׁנַ֥ת שְׁתַּ֖יִם לְדָרְיָ֑וֶשׁ הָיָה֙ דְּבַר־ יְהוָ֔ה אֶל־ חַגַּ֥י הַנָּבִ֖יא לֵאמֹֽר׃
verses.transliteration: bə·‘eś·rîm wə·’ar·bā·‘āh lat·tə·šî·‘î biš·naṯ šə·ta·yim lə·ḏā·rə·yā·weš hā·yāh də·ḇar- Yah·weh ’el- ḥag·gay han·nā·ḇî lê·mōr
verses.literal: On the twenty-fourth day . . . of the ninth month in the second year of Darius the word of the LORD came to Haggai the prophet saying
verses.literalPt: Ao vigésimo quarto dia do mês nono, no segundo ano de Dario, veio a palavra do SENHOR por intermédio do profeta Ageu, dizendo:

verses.original: כֹּ֥ה אָמַ֖ר יְהוָ֣ה צְבָא֑וֹת שְׁאַל־ נָ֧א אֶת־ הַכֹּהֲנִ֛ים תּוֹרָ֖ה לֵאמֹֽר׃
verses.transliteration: kōh ’ā·mar Yah·weh ṣə·ḇā·’ō·wṯ šə·’al- nā ’eṯ- hak·kō·hă·nîm tō·w·rāh lê·mōr
verses.literal: This is what the LORD of Hosts says Ask . . . the priests for a ruling . . .
verses.literalPt: Assim diz o SENHOR dos Exércitos: Pergunta agora aos sacerdotes, acerca da lei, dizendo:

verses.original: הֵ֣ן׀ יִשָּׂא־ אִ֨ישׁ בְּשַׂר־ קֹ֜דֶשׁ בִּכְנַ֣ף בִּגְד֗וֹ וְנָגַ֣ע בִּ֠כְנָפוֹ אֶל־ הַלֶּ֨חֶם וְאֶל־ הַנָּזִ֜יד וְאֶל־ הַיַּ֧יִן וְאֶל־ שֶׁ֛מֶן וְאֶל־ כָּל־ מַאֲכָ֖ל הֲיִקְדָּ֑שׁ וַיַּעֲנ֧וּ הַכֹּהֲנִ֛ים וַיֹּאמְר֖וּ לֹֽא׃
verses.transliteration: hên yiś·śā- ’îš bə·śar- qō·ḏeš biḵ·nap̄ biḡ·ḏōw wə·nā·ḡa‘ biḵ·nā·p̄ōw ’el- hal·le·ḥem wə·’el- han·nā·zîḏ wə·’el- hay·ya·yin wə·’el- še·men wə·’el- kāl- ma·’ă·ḵāl hă·yiq·dāš way·ya·‘ă·nū hak·kō·hă·nîm way·yō·mə·rū lō
verses.literal: If a man carries consecrated meat in the fold of his garment and it . . . touches bread . . . stew . . . wine . . . oil . . . or any other food does that item become holy No . . . replied the priests
verses.literalPt: Se alguém leva carne santa na orla das suas vestes, e com ela tocar no pão, ou no guisado, ou no vinho, ou no azeite, ou em outro qualquer mantimento, porventura ficará isto santificado? E os sacerdotes responderam: Não.

verses.original: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר חַגַּ֔י אִם־ יִגַּ֧ע טְמֵא־ נֶ֛פֶשׁ בְּכָל־ אֵ֖לֶּה הֲיִטְמָ֑א וַיַּעֲנ֧וּ הַכֹּהֲנִ֛ים וַיֹּאמְר֖וּ יִטְמָֽא׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer ḥag·gay ’im- yig·ga‘ ṭə·mê- ne·p̄eš bə·ḵāl ’êl·leh hă·yiṭ·mā way·ya·‘ă·nū hak·kō·hă·nîm way·yō·mə·rū yiṭ·mā
verses.literal: So Haggai asked If one who is defiled by contact with a corpse touches any of these does it become defiled Yes, it becomes defiled the priests . . . answered
verses.literalPt: E disse Ageu: Se alguém que for contaminado pelo contato com o corpo morto, tocar nalguma destas coisas, ficará ela imunda? E os sacerdotes responderam, dizendo: Ficará imunda.

verses.original: וַיַּ֨עַן חַגַּ֜י וַיֹּ֗אמֶר כֵּ֣ן הָֽעָם־ הַ֠זֶּה וְכֵן־ הַגּ֨וֹי הַזֶּ֤ה לְפָנַי֙ נְאֻם־ יְהוָ֔ה וְכֵ֖ן כָּל־ מַעֲשֵׂ֣ה יְדֵיהֶ֑ם וַאֲשֶׁ֥ר יַקְרִ֛יבוּ שָׁ֖ם טָמֵ֥א הֽוּא׃
verses.transliteration: way·ya·‘an ḥag·gay way·yō·mer kên hā·‘ām- haz·zeh wə·ḵên- hag·gō·w haz·zeh lə·p̄ā·nay nə·’um- Yah·weh wə·ḵên kāl- ma·‘ă·śêh yə·ḏê·hem wa·’ă·šer yaq·rî·ḇū šām ṭā·mê hū
verses.literal: Then Haggai . . . replied So it is with this people and this nation before Me declares the LORD and so it is with every work of their hands whatever they offer there is defiled . . .
verses.literalPt: Então respondeu Ageu, dizendo: Assim é este povo, e assim é esta nação diante de mim, diz o SENHOR; e assim é toda a obra das suas mãos; e tudo o que ali oferecem imundo é.

verses.original: וְעַתָּה֙ שִֽׂימוּ־ נָ֣א לְבַבְכֶ֔ם מִן־ הַיּ֥וֹם הַזֶּ֖ה וָמָ֑עְלָה מִטֶּ֧רֶם שֽׂוּם־ אֶ֛בֶן אֶל־ אֶ֖בֶן בְּהֵיכַ֥ל יְהוָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: wə·‘at·tāh śî·mū- nā lə·ḇaḇ·ḵem min- hay·yō·wm haz·zeh wā·mā·‘ə·lāh miṭ·ṭe·rem śūm- ’e·ḇen ’el- ’e·ḇen bə·hê·ḵal Yah·weh
verses.literal: Now consider carefully from this day forward Before one stone was placed on another in the temple of the LORD
verses.literalPt: Agora, pois, eu vos rogo, considerai isto, desde este dia em diante, antes que se lançasse pedra sobre pedra no templo do SENHOR,

verses.original: מִֽהְיוֹתָ֥ם בָּא֙ אֶל־ עֲרֵמַ֣ת עֶשְׂרִ֔ים וְהָיְתָ֖ה עֲשָׂרָ֑ה בָּ֣א אֶל־ הַיֶּ֗קֶב לַחְשֹׂף֙ חֲמִשִּׁ֣ים פּוּרָ֔ה וְהָיְתָ֖ה עֶשְׂרִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: mih·yō·w·ṯām bā ’el- ‘ă·rê·maṯ ‘eś·rîm wə·hā·yə·ṯāh ‘ă·śā·rāh bā ’el- hay·ye·qeḇ laḥ·śōp̄ ḥă·miš·šîm pū·rāh wə·hā·yə·ṯāh ‘eś·rîm
verses.literal: from that time when one came expecting a heap of twenty ephahs of grain there were but ten When one came to the winepress to draw out fifty baths there were but twenty
verses.literalPt: Antes que sucedessem estas coisas, vinha alguém a um montão de grão, de vinte medidas, e havia somente dez; quando vinha ao lagar para tirar cinqüenta, havia somente vinte.

verses.original: הִכֵּ֨יתִי אֶתְכֶ֜ם בַּשִּׁדָּפ֤וֹן וּבַיֵּֽרָקוֹן֙ וּבַבָּרָ֔ד אֵ֖ת כָּל־ מַעֲשֵׂ֣ה יְדֵיכֶ֑ם וְאֵין־ אֶתְכֶ֥ם אֵלַ֖י נְאֻם־ יְהוָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: hik·kê·ṯî ’eṯ·ḵem baš·šid·dā·p̄ō·wn ū·ḇay·yê·rā·qō·wn ū·ḇab·bā·rāḏ ’êṯ kāl- ma·‘ă·śêh yə·ḏê·ḵem wə·’ên- ’eṯ·ḵem ’ê·lay nə·’um- Yah·weh
verses.literal: I struck you all the work of your hands with blight mildew and hail but you did not turn to Me declares the LORD
verses.literalPt: Feri-vos com queimadura, e com ferrugem, e com saraiva, em toda a obra das vossas mãos, e não houve entre vós quem voltasse para mim, diz o SENHOR.

verses.original: שִׂימוּ־ נָ֣א לְבַבְכֶ֔ם מִן־ הַיּ֥וֹם הַזֶּ֖ה וָמָ֑עְלָה מִיּוֹם֩ עֶשְׂרִ֨ים וְאַרְבָּעָ֜ה לַתְּשִׁיעִ֗י לְמִן־ הַיּ֛וֹם אֲשֶׁר־ יֻסַּ֥ד הֵֽיכַל־ יְהוָ֖ה שִׂ֥ימוּ לְבַבְכֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: śî·mū- nā lə·ḇaḇ·ḵem min- hay·yō·wm haz·zeh wā·mā·‘ə·lāh mî·yō·wm ‘eś·rîm wə·’ar·bā·‘āh lat·tə·šî·‘î lə·min- hay·yō·wm ’ă·šer- yus·saḏ hê·ḵal- Yah·weh śî·mū lə·ḇaḇ·ḵem
verses.literal: Consider carefully . . . . . . from this day forward from the twenty-fourth . . . day of the ninth month the day the foundation of the LORD’s temple was laid consider carefully . . .
verses.literalPt: Considerai, pois, vos rogo, desde este dia em diante; desde o vigésimo quarto dia do mês nono, desde o dia em que se fundou o templo do SENHOR, considerai essas coisas.

verses.original: הַע֤וֹד הַזֶּ֙רַע֙ בַּמְּגוּרָ֔ה וְעַד־ הַגֶּ֨פֶן וְהַתְּאֵנָ֧ה וְהָרִמּ֛וֹן וְעֵ֥ץ הַזַּ֖יִת לֹ֣א נָשָׂ֑א מִן־ הַיּ֥וֹם הַזֶּ֖ה אֲבָרֵֽךְ׃ס
verses.transliteration: ha·‘ō·wḏ haz·ze·ra‘ bam·mə·ḡū·rāh wə·‘aḏ- hag·ge·p̄en wə·hat·tə·’ê·nāh wə·hā·rim·mō·wn wə·‘êṣ haz·za·yiṯ lō nā·śā min- hay·yō·wm haz·zeh ’ă·ḇā·rêḵ
verses.literal: Is there still seed in the barn The vine the fig the pomegranate and the olive tree have not yet yielded fruit But from this day on I will bless you
verses.literalPt: Porventura há ainda semente no celeiro? Além disso a videira, a figueira, a romeira, a oliveira, não têm dado os seus frutos; mas desde este dia vos abençoarei.

verses.original: וַיְהִ֨י דְבַר־ יְהוָ֤ה׀ שֵׁנִית֙ אֶל־ חַגַּ֔י בְּעֶשְׂרִ֧ים וְאַרְבָּעָ֛ה לַחֹ֖דֶשׁ לֵאמֹֽר׃
verses.transliteration: way·hî ḏə·ḇar- Yah·weh šê·nîṯ ’el- ḥag·gay bə·‘eś·rîm wə·’ar·bā·‘āh la·ḥō·ḏeš lê·mōr
verses.literal: For the second time that day the twenty-fourth . . . day of the month the word of the LORD came to Haggai saying
verses.literalPt: E veio a palavra do SENHOR segunda vez a Ageu, aos vinte e quatro dias do mês, dizendo:

verses.original: אֱמֹ֕ר אֶל־ זְרֻבָּבֶ֥ל פַּֽחַת־ יְהוּדָ֖ה לֵאמֹ֑ר אֲנִ֣י מַרְעִ֔ישׁ אֶת־ הַשָּׁמַ֖יִם וְאֶת־ הָאָֽרֶץ׃
verses.transliteration: ’ĕ·mōr ’el- zə·rub·bā·ḇel pa·ḥaṯ- yə·hū·ḏāh lê·mōr ’ă·nî mar·‘îš ’eṯ- haš·šā·ma·yim wə·’eṯ- hā·’ā·reṣ
verses.literal: Tell . . . Zerubbabel governor of Judah that I am about to shake the heavens and the earth
verses.literalPt: Fala a Zorobabel, governador de Judá, dizendo: Farei tremer os céus e a terra;

verses.original: וְהָֽפַכְתִּי֙ כִּסֵּ֣א מַמְלָכ֔וֹת וְהִ֨שְׁמַדְתִּ֔י חֹ֖זֶק מַמְלְכ֣וֹת הַגּוֹיִ֑ם וְהָפַכְתִּ֤י מֶרְכָּבָה֙ וְרֹ֣כְבֶ֔יהָ וְיָרְד֤וּ סוּסִים֙ וְרֹ֣כְבֵיהֶ֔ם אִ֖ישׁ בְּחֶ֥רֶב אָחִֽיו׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hā·p̄aḵ·tî kis·sê mam·lā·ḵō·wṯ wə·hiš·maḏ·tî ḥō·zeq mam·lə·ḵō·wṯ hag·gō·w·yim wə·hā·p̄aḵ·tî mer·kā·ḇāh wə·rō·ḵə·ḇe·hā wə·yā·rə·ḏū sū·sîm wə·rō·ḵə·ḇê·hem ’îš bə·ḥe·reḇ ’ā·ḥîw
verses.literal: I will overturn royal thrones and destroy the power of the kingdoms of the nations I will overturn chariots and their riders horses and their riders will fall each by the sword of his brother
verses.literalPt: E transtornarei o trono dos reinos, e destruirei a força dos reinos dos gentios; e transtornarei os carros e os que neles andam; e os cavalos e os seus cavaleiros cairão, cada um pela espada do seu irmão.

verses.original: בַּיּ֣וֹם הַה֣וּא נְאֻם־ יְהוָ֣ה צְבָא֡וֹת אֶ֠קָּחֲךָ זְרֻבָּבֶ֨ל בֶּן־ שְׁאַלְתִּיאֵ֤ל עַבְדִּי֙ נְאֻם־ יְהוָ֔ה וְשַׂמְתִּ֖יךָ כַּֽחוֹתָ֑ם כִּֽי־ בְךָ֣ בָחַ֔רְתִּי נְאֻ֖ם יְהוָ֥ה צְבָאֽוֹת׃
verses.transliteration: bay·yō·wm ha·hū nə·’um- Yah·weh ṣə·ḇā·’ō·wṯ ’eq·qā·ḥă·ḵā zə·rub·bā·ḇel ben- šə·’al·tî·’êl ‘aḇ·dî nə·’um- Yah·weh wə·śam·tî·ḵā ka·ḥō·w·ṯām kî- ḇə·ḵā ḇā·ḥar·tî nə·’um Yah·weh ṣə·ḇā·’ō·wṯ
verses.literal: On that day declares the LORD of Hosts I will take you My servant Zerubbabel son of Shealtiel declares the LORD and I will make you like My signet ring for I have chosen you declares the LORD of Hosts
verses.literalPt: Naquele dia, diz o SENHOR dos Exércitos, tomar-te-ei, ó Zorobabel, servo meu, filho de Sealtiel, diz o SENHOR, e far-te-ei como um anel de selar; porque te escolhi, diz o SENHOR dos Exércitos.
